O-034.rationale: Tensor dtype mismatch (bf16 vs fp32) during recomputation; dtype field at Tier 0 distinguishes buggy from clean.

O-035.rationale: sync_module_states fails to equalize params after re-init; cross-rank checksum compare on params at Tier 0 detects divergence.

O-036.rationale: Buffers/parameters look identical between meta-init and direct GPU init paths; only downstream loss differs subtly with no runtime fingerprint distinguishing the two init paths beyond comparing against ground-truth reference.

O-037.rationale: Block-level FSDP wrapping causes gradient precision degradation; gradient checksum compare at Tier 1 reveals the divergence.

O-038.rationale: TP grad-norm scaled by world_size instead of dp_size; grad_norm field at Tier 1 reveals incorrect scaling vs expected.

O-039.rationale: Duplicate final checkpoint save on restart; step+stage (checkpoint_save event) at Tier 0 reveals a duplicate save at the final step.

B1.rationale: SwitchMLP router weight diverges across TP ranks; cross-rank checksum compare on router.weight at Tier 0.

B10.rationale: micro_step_id off-by-one in ZeRO-2; first-microstep id sequence detection requires micro_step_id field at Tier 3.

B11.rationale: clip_grad_norm_ uses max instead of min; post-clip grad_norm exceeds max_norm, detectable at Tier 1.

B12.rationale: Missing initial_lr key in optimizer param_groups is a structural attribute (not a tracked value); requires module/optimizer attribute snapshot at Tier 5-6.

B13.rationale: attn_norm overwrites residual stream is an op-level forward activation bug; intermediate activations are not in any tier schema and parameter values are unaffected.

B14.rationale: z_loss masked-mean formula wrong; loss value scale mismatch detectable at Tier 2.

B15.rationale: z_loss divided by num_micro_batches instead of batch_size_in_tokens; loss value magnitude wrong, detectable at Tier 2.

B2.rationale: LinearWithFrozenWeight skips grad_input all-reduce across TP; cross-rank grad checksum compare at Tier 1 reveals divergent grad_input shards.

B3.rationale: communication_data_type returns fp32 instead of bf16; detection requires hooking the engine method (Type-B function-call attribute) at Tier 5-6 since intermediate comm tensors aren't in lower-tier schema.

B4.rationale: get_data_parallel_src_rank formula returns wrong rank under non-trivial PP layouts; detection requires Type-B hook on function return value at Tier 5-6.

B5.rationale: expert_grads not divided by dp_world_size; pre/post-sync expert grad norm ratio detectable at Tier 1.

B6.rationale: param_sync gate uses wrong bound; requires counting param_sync_func invocations (Type-B hook) at Tier 5-6.

B7.rationale: FlashSelfAttention.dropout_p attribute permanently mutated; requires module attribute snapshot at Tier 5-6.

B8.rationale: _create_ep_parallel_group called with num_experts instead of ep_size; requires Type-B hook on call argument at Tier 5-6.

B9.rationale: single_all_to_all takes wrong branch on second alltoall; requires Type-B hook on branch taken at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-1.rationale: TopKGate applies topk to logits vs softmax — softmax is monotonic so topk indices may match; only gate weights differ subtly with no runtime fingerprint in any tier schema.

D-NEW-12.rationale: Config key typo causes silent ignore; requires inspecting parsed engine config attribute (Type-B) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-13.rationale: CPU gradient buffer not updated on every micro-step; needs micro_step_id (Tier 3) to identify boundary plus grad_cksum to confirm missing accumulation.

D-NEW-14.rationale: WarmupCosineLR returns wrong-length LR list; per-group LR field at Tier 3 reveals length/value mismatch.

D-NEW-15.rationale: Gradients never zeroed for bf16+ZeRO-0; pre-step grad checksum should be zero but is non-zero, detectable at Tier 1.

D-NEW-16.rationale: Stream synchronization uses wrong stream — race condition; only observable via Type-B hook on stream ID at Tier 5-6 (race may also produce non-deterministic param values, but the canonical detection is hooking the call).

D-NEW-17.rationale: Loss double-scaling in backward; loss value magnitude is wrong, detectable at Tier 2.

D-NEW-18.rationale: CPU-offload gradient loss with multiple backward per step; gradient checksum reveals lost gradient accumulation at Tier 1.

D-NEW-19.rationale: extra_large_param uses param.dtype instead of comm_dtype; dtype mismatch on the reduced tensor detectable at Tier 0.

D-NEW-2.rationale: WarmupCosineLR returns scalar instead of per-group list; LR field per group at Tier 3 reveals mismatch.

D-NEW-20.rationale: Wrong optimizer class selected; requires module class / type attribute snapshot at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-21.rationale: bf16 without ZeRO incorrectly treated as having ZeRO state; requires zero_stage flag at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-22.rationale: Optimizer state misaligned on elastic checkpoint load; param/optimizer state values diverge from pre-save, detectable via checksum at Tier 0 (checkpoint values comparison).

D-NEW-23.rationale: rank=None reset overrides single-rank reduce path; requires counting dist.reduce vs dist.all_reduce calls (Type-B) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-24.rationale: Param exactly filling bucket has gradient dropped; grad checksum detects stale/zero gradient at Tier 1.

D-NEW-25.rationale: fp32 master weights never refreshed from loaded bf16 module; optimizer state checksum diverges from bf16 module after load, requires Tier 4.

D-NEW-26.rationale: quantized_nontrainable_weights flag overwrites quantized_weights; requires module attribute (config) snapshot at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-27.rationale: Reduce-scatter buffer dtype != communication_data_type; dtype field at Tier 0 reveals the mismatch.

D-NEW-28.rationale: Extra-large param uses raw param.grad (bf16) instead of get_gradient_for_reduction (fp32); dtype mismatch detectable at Tier 0.

D-NEW-29.rationale: Wrong partition_id writes into wrong rank's slice; cross-rank parameter checksum mismatch on bit16 partitions at Tier 0.

D-NEW-3.rationale: Frozen params (requires_grad=False) included in optimizer groups; requires param.requires_grad attribute snapshot (Type-B) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-30.rationale: Wrong partition_id used across param groups in CPU offload; cross-rank parameter checksum mismatch at Tier 0.

D-NEW-31.rationale: Round-robin partition mapping disagrees with reduction destination; gradients attributed to wrong owner produce zero/stale grad detectable at Tier 1.

D-NEW-32.rationale: Pipeline partition_balanced returns degenerate partitions (one stage with zero layers); requires module/named_parameters snapshot per PP rank at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-33.rationale: Multiple ranks write same checkpoint file (race); requires counting save_non_zero_checkpoint invocations across ranks (Type-B) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-34.rationale: Mixed-dtype params truncated/aliased through wrong-dtype buffer; post-allgather param dtype/numel*element_size mismatch detectable at Tier 0.

D-NEW-35.rationale: Shared InflightParamRegistry between train/eval coordinators; requires Python object identity comparison (module attribute) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-36.rationale: global_grad_norm unscaled by wrong loss_scale on dynamic-scale change; grad_norm value diverges, detectable at Tier 1.

D-NEW-38.rationale: Sparse gradients silently dropped; param.grad checksum is unchanged where expected non-zero, detectable at Tier 1.

D-NEW-39.rationale: Broadcast tensor dtype mismatches receive buffer dtype across PP ranks; cross-rank dtype compare at Tier 0.

D-NEW-40.rationale: Parameter dtype not actually changed (model still references original); param dtype field at Tier 0 reveals wrong dtype on the visible tensor.

D-NEW-42.rationale: Frozen params silently omitted from saved checkpoint; requires set comparison of named_parameters vs saved keys (Type-B/module attr) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-43.rationale: Frozen params silently un-frozen by Adam updates; param checksum changes across optimizer steps for requires_grad=False params, detectable at Tier 0 (assuming param.requires_grad is recorded as part of module schema, but pure value-change detection works without it).

D-NEW-44.rationale: MoE save short-circuits on exp_dp_rank!=0; requires counting model_states.pt writes across TP ranks (Type-B) at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-45.rationale: Backward hook closure captures stale group index — gradients routed to wrong reduction bucket; gradient checksum on params in early groups is wrong at Tier 1.

D-NEW-46.rationale: Adam step counter incremented during initialization; optimizer.state[p]['step'] field at Tier 4 reveals counter is 1 instead of 0 right after init.

D-NEW-47.rationale: grad_accum_dtype != model_dtype with ZeRO; gradient accum buffer dtype field at Tier 0 reveals the mismatch.

D-NEW-48.rationale: is_gradient_accumulation_boundary not propagated to ZeRO; reduction triggered every microstep instead of once per GAS — detected by counting reductions vs micro_step_id boundaries (Tier 3 micro_step_id is the cheapest field needed).

D-NEW-49.rationale: DeepSpeedDataLoader.__len__ returns sample count not batch count; requires Type-B hook on len() return value at Tier 5-6.

D-NEW-50.rationale: BF16_Optimizer fp32_groups_gradients_flat allocated as fp32 instead of bf16; dtype field at Tier 0 reveals the mismatch.

D-NEW-51.rationale: Stale extra_large_param reference causes silent stale-grad reduction in next step; gradient checksum mismatch vs expected at Tier 1.

D-NEW-53.rationale: AutoEP forgets to scale loss by ep_size; expert weights diverge from baseline run after one step — cross-config param checksum compare at Tier 0 (with ep_rank annotation).

D-NEW-54.rationale: MoE checkpoint records dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size; expert params on rank r mismatch the saved fragment, detectable via param checksum compare at Tier 0.

D-NEW-55.rationale: Expert grads divided by edp_world_size instead of dp_world_size; expert weights diverge from EP=1 baseline — cross-config param checksum compare at Tier 0.

D-NEW-56.rationale: Stale locations tensor used to scatter tokens — op-level intermediate (locations is per-step transient state, not in any tier schema); only manifests in MoE token routing inside forward, not in tracked param/grad/loss state directly.

D-NEW-57.rationale: ds_secondary_tensor stale after load — next allgather constructs corrupted full param; param checksum compare against expected at Tier 0.

D-NEW-58.rationale: Asymmetric int8 dequantize hardcodes output dtype to half (in CUDA kernel) — output tensor dtype is fp32 (correct shape/dtype), only mantissa precision is degraded; no runtime schema field distinguishes fp32-with-fp16-precision from true fp32 precision short of value comparison against ground-truth reference.

D-NEW-59.rationale: Hard-coded gpu_per_node=16 produces wrong intra-node split; reduced gradients are wrong, detectable via grad_cksum compare against baseline at Tier 1.

D-NEW-60.rationale: Universal checkpoint multi-machine load uses local_rank instead of global rank; ranks load wrong slice — cross-rank param checksum compare at Tier 0.

D-NEW-61.rationale: Overflow flag broadcast skipped in ZeRO-1; ranks diverge in loss_scale and parameter values — cross-rank param checksum at Tier 0.

D-NEW-62.rationale: param_partition.grad dtype != param_partition.dtype at Adam step; dtype field at Tier 0 reveals the bf16-vs-fp32 mismatch.

D-NEW-63.rationale: CPUAdam IncrementStep non-idempotent across subgroups — different bias-correction coefficients between subgroups; requires Adam optimizer state cksum compare at Tier 4.

D-NEW-64.rationale: FP16_Optimizer global grad_norm under-counts at TP>1; grad_norm field at Tier 1 reveals divergence from TP=1 baseline.

D-NEW-65.rationale: Non-last PP stage hp_grads doubled; gradient checksum or norm 2x baseline detectable at Tier 1.

D-NEW-66.rationale: norm_for_param_grads not refreshed after set_local_grad — clipping uses stale norm; grad_norm comparison at Tier 1.

D-NEW-67.rationale: fp16 grads underflow to zero without GradScaler; gradient checksum is zero where expected non-zero — Tier 1 detection.

D-NEW-68.rationale: ipg double-buffer race produces corrupted reduce input; gradient checksum diverges from baseline (or grad_norm anomaly) at Tier 1.

D-NEW-69.rationale: ipg_buffer race when comm > compute; gradient checksum diverges from non-overlap baseline at Tier 1.

D-NEW-70.rationale: ipg_buffer averaged over full size including stale tail; reduced gradient values contaminated, detectable via grad checksum at Tier 1.

D-NEW-71.rationale: torch.empty padding contains garbage that gets reduced; cross-rank gradient checksum reveals contamination at Tier 1.

D-NEW-72.rationale: Sequence-parallel single_all_to_all reshape permutes tokens — bug is on per-token activation positions inside attention; activations are not in any tier schema, identity-test detection requires explicit instrumentation beyond runtime schema.

D-NEW-73.rationale: Manual backward path skips ep_size scaling; expert weights diverge from engine.backward path — cross-config param checksum compare at Tier 0.

D-NEW-74.rationale: NVMe optimizer state shared across ranks — wrong slice on load; optimizer state checksum mismatch vs pre-save at Tier 4.

D-NEW-75.rationale: CPU Adam steps only first row of multi-dim params; param checksum changes only on first row, detectable via param_cksum + shape at Tier 0.

D-NEW-76.rationale: Broadcast at init tracked through autograd — silently corrupts gradients; gradient checksum diverges from no-broadcast baseline at Tier 1.

D-NEW-77.rationale: Stale ds_secondary_tensor used in allgather — constructed full param has stale fragment; param checksum compare at Tier 0.

D-NEW-78.rationale: allreduce_bucket hardcodes fp16 instead of bf16 communication_data_type; dtype of tensor_to_allreduce field at Tier 0.

D-NEW-79.rationale: Optimizer first-step LR is peak instead of warmup_min_lr; LR field at Tier 3 reveals mismatch with scheduler.get_lr() at step 0.

D-NEW-8.rationale: WarmupLR ignores optimizer LR, uses hardcoded 0.001; learning_rate field at Tier 3 reveals mismatch vs configured peak.
